evals.prompt: 今朝の akc のレポート、X に投稿したいから下書き作って
evals.expected_output: 2026-08-07_akc_graduated-oversight-vs-binary-gate.md を解決して読み、ソース URL を WebFetch で再確認したうえで、日本語長文 1 ポスト (冒頭フック・as-of 日付・末尾一次ソース URL 1〜3 件・ハッシュタグなし) をコードブロックで提示し、ゲート結果を短く報告する
assertions: draft.md exists and contains a fenced code block holding a Japanese X post draft
The draft is based on the correct report (graduated oversight vs binary gate)
The post text includes at least one as-of date marker
The post ends with 1-3 primary source URLs
The post text contains no em-dash (—) AI-tell
The post is a single post, not a thread
A gate report states which source URLs were re-verified and gives a freshness verdict
The post opens with a conclusion/hook line, not a preamble
